plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Journalism (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Must earn a grade of C or better.
[grid1 fn2] JOUR 100-499 cannot be used to fulfill this requirement.
[grid1 fn3] Select from JOUR 100-499 and/or other courses in consultation with the program director or designee to form a supporting focus area.
[grid1 fn4] Select any 100-499 course not used elsewhere. Only 14 hours of KINE 199 ; AERS 100-499; MLSC 100-499; NVSC 100-499; SOMS 100-499 may be used towards general electives.
[grid1 fn5] Minor to be selected from among approved university minors. Consult with advisor regarding how to declare desired minor. Courses fulfilling core curriculum requirements may apply to the minor and therefore some of these courses may become electives. Minors will range between 15 and 18 hours.
